applications.title: Job Search Agent
applications.description: A job-search assistant that collects employer listings, ranks eligible roles, prepares tailored application material, and tracks the application pipeline.
applications.scope: Submission assistance pauses for candidate confirmation and unsupported or ambiguous steps.

applications.title: Lucid Vocabulary Coach
applications.description: A mobile-first English-learning app with focused vocabulary lessons, usage exercises, spaced review, and regular quizzes.
applications.scope: Progress is stored in D1 with device caching for offline continuity.

applications.title: UAE F&B Product Studio
applications.description: A guided workspace that takes a beverage brief through concept comparison, prototype formulation, costing, packaging, sourcing, branding, and exportable product dossiers.
applications.scope: Production hosting and frontend production authentication remain deferred.

applications.title: BudgetTracker
applications.description: A budgeting and cash-flow application with expense tracking, payoff scenarios, savings forecasts, and data export.
applications.scope: Includes projection, actuals, scenario tools, and savings workflows. This showcase contains no personal financial records.

applications.title: Trader Risk Cockpit
applications.description: Read-only trading analytics that turns public Hyperliquid fills and funding history into an auditable ledger and performance, risk, and behavior insights.
applications.scope: Includes a deterministic mock mode; live integration needs the application’s configuration.

applications.title: Whisper
applications.description: A voice-journaling pipeline: receive a Telegram prompt, reply with a voice note, transcribe it locally, and keep the text in SQLite.
applications.scope: The initial capture version deletes transient audio. Search and analysis are later work.

applications.title: CryptoForge Lab
applications.description: A noncustodial token-creation workspace with AI concept generation, launch discovery, conflict checks, wallet-reviewed launch preparation, and post-launch analytics.
applications.scope: Wallet submissions depend on an explicit write configuration. This is a software project, not a claim of investment performance.

applications.title: BullsOf2028
applications.description: A multi-chain intelligence platform with deterministic asset eligibility, ranking, ingestion, historical snapshots, and asset and category pages.
applications.scope: Production activation remains gated. Rankings are algorithmic, not investment recommendations.

applications.title: Unified Crypto Swap
applications.description: A purchase planner that compares potential funding sources and estimated costs using a demo portfolio or a bounded public-address scan.
applications.scope: Live scanning is bounded to canonical USDC on Base and Arbitrum. No wallet signing or transaction execution is implemented.

applications.title: Unified Wallet
applications.description: An Ethereum/EVM browser wallet with encrypted recovery, account management, asset discovery, token transfers, dapp approvals, and reviewed swaps.
applications.scope: Local installation only. Independent security assessment is outstanding; it is not a publicly released wallet.

applications.title: AI Camera Copilot
applications.description: A local camera assistant for subject tracking, composition checks, and stabilized framing guidance, with annotated video and structured reports.
applications.scope: Recorded-video phases 0–2 are documented as complete; live HDMI capture remains deferred.

applications.title: Room Comfort Autopilot
applications.description: Two related implementations that turn replayable room-sensor data into quality-aware comfort labels, short forecasts, and explainable recommendations.
applications.scope: Observation and mock actuation only. It is not a certified safety or building-control system.

applications.title: AI Worship Production Director
applications.description: An offline production assistant that observes recordings or exported OBS events and suggests camera or production choices with confidence and reasons.
applications.scope: Suggestions are reviewed by an operator. It does not switch scenes or control hardware.

applications.title: Live-Stream Failure Sentinel
applications.description: An early-warning assistant that replays stream telemetry, groups likely failures, and creates incident timelines and redacted evidence for operators.
applications.scope: Includes offline replay and read-only probes. Continuous live monitoring remains disabled.

applications.title: Account Ledger Core
applications.description: A Java ledger with immutable journals, replayable account projections, authorization handling, daily close, and value-date versus knowledge-date queries.
applications.scope: An in-memory exercise; persistence, concurrency, and automatic hold expiry are outside its implemented scope.

engineering.title: Load Balancer
engineering.description: A TypeScript implementation of request distribution across backend servers, including round-robin routing.

engineering.title: Redis & Memcached
engineering.description: A study of Redis and Memcached operations and performance comparisons.

engineering.title: WebSockets & Long Polling
engineering.description: A TypeScript communication-patterns project with a browser client.

engineering.title: E-commerce Order Service
engineering.description: A Java/Spring Boot order CRUD service with PostgreSQL, adapted from an existing Kotlin exercise.

engineering.title: Log My Ticket
engineering.description: A MEAN-stack application for logging tasks and incidents.

engineering.title: Retail Store Discounts
engineering.description: A retail discount API that applies customer-type rules, bill discounts, and grocery exclusions.

engineering.title: React Currency
engineering.description: An earlier React application. See the repository for source and setup.

engineering.title: Keyword Management Tool
engineering.description: An earlier Gradle-based application. See the repository for implementation details.

engineering.title: CompletableFuture Study
engineering.description: A Java concurrency proof of concept inspired by Java Techie.

engineering.title: Build Your Own Redis
engineering.description: Work on the CodeCrafters Redis challenge in Python. A learning project rather than a production Redis replacement.

engineering.title: Rate Limiter Lab
engineering.description: A Node.js learning scaffold with a fixed-window limiter, middleware, stress tooling, and additional algorithms left as exercises.
